itens.trecho: Uma melhoria em relação ao primeiro filme, mas ainda muito distante do que foi "Senhor dos Anéis". Este filme continua a trilogia "O Hobbit", que é uma prequela de "O Senhor dos Anéis".

7 out of 10 stars would normally be considered quite okay and I guess you could say that this movie is quite okay. However, it has a reputation to live up to. As a movie in the Tolkien universe and with LOTR and The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey this movie have a lot to live up to and, as far as I am concerned, it does not.
I'm afraid I still really struggled with the lightweight casting here, but once I'd convinced myself to get over that, I found this to be a far more characterful and entertaining adventure.
